note: Made-up audit trail entries for the demo page. Each entry is dated secondsAgo before the moment the page is opened, so the default period always shows some. All names, addresses and texts are invented.
hints: Type My_Set and Region__c in the search box: every change about one permission set and one field, with who and when.
Open "Kind of change" and press Hide on the busiest kind to take the noise out.
Two people are called Sam Rivera; the Person list tells them apart by username.
Pick Everything Salesforce keeps, then Stop, to see how a partly read list is announced.
Pick Riley Quinn (type riley) and choose "Changes made to them": the entries that mention them by Id, username, email or name, and how each one matched. The second Riley Quinn is told apart by Id.
Type zoe, jamie or team.alerts@example.com to see names with accents and an email that two people share.
Pick Casey Admin and read "Changes made by them": the Login-As entries made by Sam Rivera show up marked as delegate entries.
Paste the user Id 005Dm000003Hd8qIAC (or the first 15 characters) in the person box: nobody can be read for it, but you can use the Id itself.
